target_customer: Frontier AI model labs that buy reinforcement learning environments, tasks and verifiers
problem: Training and evaluating agents on long horizon software work needs realistic simulated environments, which labs find costly to build by hand.
business_model: Data lab selling RL environments, tasks and verifiers to model labs
product_category: RL environments for long horizon agents

founders.name: Dylan Ma
founders.background_notes: Led post training research and data at Hume AI.

competitors.name: Mechanize
competitors.what: RL environments for AI coding agents

competitors.name: Prime Intellect
competitors.what: Open Environments Hub for RL environments aimed at smaller developers
competitors.traction_then: Backed by Karpathy, Founders Fund, Menlo Ventures

competitors.name: Scale AI
competitors.what: Expanded into RL environments for agents

technical_complexity.rationale: Building verifiable, realistic long horizon simulated companies and automating environment generation is research adjacent work that needs deep model training knowledge.

defensibility.rationale: Many rivals sell similar environments and labs can build in house; edge is speed, benchmark credibility and relationships with labs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded players were already in the space at founding; no acquisition of Polymath found.

market_need_then: Labs were reported in 2025 to be betting heavily on RL environments to train agents, with many startups supplying them (TechCrunch, 2025-09).

branding.domain_note: Uses polymathlabs.ai rather than an exact .com.

identity.logo: Thick wordmark SVG, design not visible
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and mission focused, with bolded key phrases.

brand_strength.rationale: Little press beyond commentary and the YC launch; other companies share the name, but the Horizon-SWE benchmark gives some awareness.

outcome_analysis: Polymath is an active Winter 2026 company that reported an $8M seed from Base10, Founders Future and YC, with strong founder backgrounds. It rides lab demand for RL environments, but competitors were already funded in 2025 and the moat is unclear. It is too early for an outcome, so success factors reflect timing and funding only.
notes: Seed amount is from the company's own YC jobs page and an aggregator reporting June 2026; month not independently confirmed, so date is year only. Simplify.jobs shows $130K total, which conflicts. Founded year 2025 per Cervin, YC says 2026. Other companies named Polymath were ignored.
